basics.name: Zhang Yunfan, Ph.D.
basics.label: Research Scientist | 3D Computer Vision | LLM
basics.summary: AI Researcher and Engineer with a Ph.D. in Computer Science and 8+ years of cross-functional experience spanning applied Generative AI, multi-turn dialogue systems, and high-performance hardware architecture. Deep expertise across the AI lifecycle — from dataset construction and SFT/RL to memory-efficient inference. Former Senior Engineer at Marvell and Skyworks with multiple granted U.S. patents.

work.name: Alibaba-NTU Global e-Sustainability CorpLab (ANGEL)
work.summary: Applied generative AI research focused on domain-specific LLMs for clinical applications, agentic reasoning over knowledge graphs, and memory-efficient inference.
highlights: Architected a multi-turn dialogue system that emulates real-world medical consultations and diagnostic workflows.
Spearheaded large-scale dataset construction from the MIMIC clinical database for SFT and conversational evaluation.
Engineered KAG and GraphRAG frameworks for the medical domain, validated against the MedQA benchmark.
Improved serving throughput and reduced latency using FlashAttention, SDPA, and vLLM.

work.name: Alibaba-NTU Singapore Joint Research Institute
work.summary: 3D computer vision and generative AI research, with production integrations into Alibaba Video products.
highlights: Architected end-to-end pipelines for 3D indoor scene synthesis and point cloud generation in PyTorch, automating 3D modeling workflows in Python and Blender.
Partnered with the Alibaba Video team to deploy models powering automated video captioning, gaming recaps, and intelligent video enhancement.

work.name: Marvell Asia Pte. Ltd.
work.summary: Digital and software architecture for high-speed, low-power storage ICs.
highlights: Architected a C# user interface integrated with hardware drivers for advanced bench testing and system-level validation.
Led digital and software architecture for the Pre-Amp team, integrating peripheral control logic and a >100 MHz digital interface for register programming.
Developed automated testing protocols that reduced full-suite evaluation time from 2 days to 3 hours.
Engineered a high-performance write driver with ultra-low power consumption, executing the full cycle from RTL design and synthesis through place-and-route.

work.name: Skyworks Global Pte. Ltd.
work.summary: Silicon controller design for 2G/3G/4G power amplifiers and SOI switch modules.
highlights: Directed silicon controller design from specification through circuit realization and ATE, achieving a 100% first-silicon success rate across all Si/SOI die designs.
Developed the SOI Band Select Switch Module with custom digital logic, level shifters, and ESD networks, driving process migration to volume production.
